Method of Attack: Malicious backdoor enabling remote access via SSH
Runtime hooking/redirection of OpenSSH's authentication routines
Injection of malicious payload into the source tree
Impacted Systems: Red Hat’s Fedora 40 and Fedora Rawhide Linux distributions
Attack Vector: Altered release tarballs with malicious backdoor
Targeting systems using amd64 architecture and glibc
Indicators of Compromise: Slower SSH logins taking a lot of CPU
Obfuscated/encrypted bash stages in tests/files/bad-3-corrupt_lzma2.xz and tests/files/good-large_compressed.lzma
